get.summary: Read every enumeration the UI renders.

type.description: The stable problem code, such as `urn:qe:problem:rules-violated`.

detail.description: What happened, when the title does not say it all; omitted otherwise.

errors.description: Input path to messages; `''` is the form-level key. Empty unless the status is 400.

code.description: A short snake_case code for the rule, such as `closure_mismatch`.

message.description: What is wrong, written for the person editing the version or the report.

area.description: A module-specific area, such as a dataset tab, a dimension tab, a release manifest row or a report section.

itemId.description:
The offending item, as a stored id's digits or, in a change-set preview, the temporary id of an item the change set created;
omitted when the violation names no single item.

itemKey.description: The offending item's key; omitted when the violation names none.

filter.description: Search text that narrows a table to the offending rows; omitted when there is none.

target.description: Where to take the user to fix a violation: an area of the editor, optionally narrowed to one item or a search.

items.description:
One reason a rule rejects a version, a report, a write or a delete: the contract's `Violation`, and with a
`DeleteBlockerCode` as its code, a `DeleteBlocker`.

violations.description: The rule violations (422) or delete blockers (409); omitted otherwise.

traceId.description: The request's trace id on a 500; omitted otherwise.

schema.description:
The one error body of the API (`application/problem+json`, blueprint 01, OI-06): 400 carries `errors`, 409
carries `violations` for delete blockers and `detail` otherwise, 422 carries `violations`, 401, 403 and
404 carry the title only, and 500 carries `traceId`. Built by `Problems`.

put.summary:
Changes a version's status. Leaving draft runs the kind's publication rules, retiring a published version runs its
retirement rules, and publishing stamps the publication time. Publishing a living kind's version also retires the version
published before it; a living version cannot be retired by hand.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant that owns the version.

409.description: The lifecycle does not allow moving from the current status to the target; the detail names both.

200.description: The transition applied; the body is the version's new state.

400.description: The kind or the target status is not a known value.

422.description: Publication or retirement rules rejected the transition and the status is unchanged; `violations` lists why.

check, because its edits are live and only field rules guard them as they are made.

put.summary: Edits a report's display name, type and payload; the semantic revision advances when the report is enabled.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant that owns the report.

400.description: The input breaks a field rule; errors are keyed by camelCase JSON path.

404.description: An id in the route names no row in the tenant.

type.description: The stable problem code, such as `urn:qe:problem:rules-violated`.

detail.description: What happened, when the title does not say it all; omitted otherwise.

errors.description: Input path to messages; `''` is the form-level key. Empty unless the status is 400.

code.description: A short snake_case code for the rule, such as `closure_mismatch`.

message.description: What is wrong, written for the person editing the version or the report.

area.description: A module-specific area, such as a dataset tab, a dimension tab, a release manifest row or a report section.

itemId.description:
The offending item, as a stored id's digits or, in a change-set preview, the temporary id of an item the change set created;
omitted when the violation names no single item.

itemKey.description: The offending item's key; omitted when the violation names none.

filter.description: Search text that narrows a table to the offending rows; omitted when there is none.

target.description: Where to take the user to fix a violation: an area of the editor, optionally narrowed to one item or a search.

items.description:
One reason a rule rejects a version, a report, a write or a delete: the contract's `Violation`, and with a
`DeleteBlockerCode` as its code, a `DeleteBlocker`.

violations.description: The rule violations (422) or delete blockers (409); omitted otherwise.

traceId.description: The request's trace id on a 500; omitted otherwise.

itemId.description:

omitted when the violation names no single item.

filter.description: Search text that narrows a table to the offending rows; omitted when there is none.

target.description: Where to take the user to fix a violation: an area of the editor, optionally narrowed to one item or a search.

items.description:

source's other rows keep their rules, so an item may add into several rows. While the report is enabled, the write is
checked against the report rules first, such as that a factor other than 1 only scales measures that apply bridge factors.

carries `violations` for delete blockers and `detail` otherwise, 422 carries `violations`, 401, 403 and
404 carry the title only, and 500 carries `traceId`. Built by `Problems`.

post.summary: Defines the system dimension of a profile, with its required roles and members.

400.description: The route does not bind.

404.description: The dimension manager offers no profile with this key.

409.description: The profile's dimension is defined already, or its key or a role key is taken.

type.description: The stable problem code, such as `urn:qe:problem:rules-violated`.

detail.description: What happened, when the title does not say it all; omitted otherwise.

errors.description: Input path to messages; `''` is the form-level key. Empty unless the status is 400.

code.description: A short snake_case code for the rule, such as `closure_mismatch`.

message.description: What is wrong, written for the person editing the version or the report.

area.description: A module-specific area, such as a dataset tab, a dimension tab, a release manifest row or a report section.

itemId.description:
The offending item, as a stored id's digits or, in a change-set preview, the temporary id of an item the change set created;
omitted when the violation names no single item.

itemKey.description: The offending item's key; omitted when the violation names none.

filter.description: Search text that narrows a table to the offending rows; omitted when there is none.

target.description: Where to take the user to fix a violation: an area of the editor, optionally narrowed to one item or a search.

items.description:
One reason a rule rejects a version, a report, a write or a delete: the contract's `Violation`, and with a
`DeleteBlockerCode` as its code, a `DeleteBlocker`.

violations.description: The rule violations (422) or delete blockers (409); omitted otherwise.

traceId.description: The request's trace id on a 500; omitted otherwise.

404 carry the title only, and 500 carries `traceId`. Built by `Problems`.
